reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: BlobRPCMinValidSlot (rpc_blob_sidecars_by_range.go:136-148) calculates minStart = max(currEpoch - minReqEpochs, DenebForkEpoch) with no Fulu deprecation check. Spec SG-011 mandates full deprecation (respond empty/reject) after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS. Attack path confirmed: post-deprecation blob_sidecars_by_range requests will be served indefinitely, violating protocol migration to data columns. Spec cross-ref: SG-011 INV-001 explicitly requires full deprecation after the deadline. Severity: Single-client bug affecting ~31% of CL nodes (Prysm share), below Medium's 5% network threshold but meets program's 'protocol violation preventing migration' criteria. Medium severity appropriate for migration blocker.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-011 INV-001: blob_sidecars_by_range fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code misread. Phase 03 analyzed streamDataColumnBatch (rpc_data_column_sidecars_by_range.go:138-168) and claimed quota check breaks mid-block. Actual code retrieves ALL sidecars for a block atomically via dataColumnStorage.Get(blockRoot, wantedDataColumnIndices) at line 143, then iterates over the complete set. The quota check at line 164 exits BETWEEN blocks, not mid-block. Each block's sidecars are either fully sent or not sent at all. Spec SG-008 INV-004 satisfied. Attack scenario invalid: quota exhaustion stops at block boundaries, preserving atomicity. False positive due to misunderstanding the Get() semantics.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-008 INV-004: all sidecars of a block must be included if any are (satisfied by atomic Get)

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: UnmarshalConfig (loader.go:56-62) performs yaml.UnmarshalStrict into BeaconChainConfig.BlobSchedule with no validation that MaxBlobsPerBlock entries <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK (4096). verifyBlobCommitmentCount (payload.go:238-240) uses params.BeaconConfig().MaxBlobsPerBlock(slot) from BlobSchedule, allowing >4096 commitments if config specifies it. SSZ serialization enforces 4096 hard limit (fieldparams). Attack path confirmed: malicious config enables protocol-valid blocks (verifyBlobCommitmentCount passes) that cannot be P2P-transmitted (SSZ rejects), causing proposer equivocation or chain stalls. Spec SG-001 INV-003 violated. Severity: Single-client misconfiguration bug (requires operator to load malicious config), affecting ~31% of CL nodes. Medium severity appropriate for consensus-breaking misconfiguration vector.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu Beacon Chain SG-001 INV-003: all max_blobs_per_block values <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: broadcastAndReceiveDataColumns (proposer.go:502-503) calls ReceiveDataColumns which only saves to storage (receive_data_column.go:10-11), never updating anti-equivocation cache. Gossip subscriber path (subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go:42) calls setSeenDataColumnIndex after import. Cache inconsistency confirmed: locally-produced columns bypass equivocation tracking. Attack scenario: validator produces column C1 for (slot, proposer, index), broadcasts it (imported without cache update), then produces equivocating column C2 for same key via different code path. C2 accepted by gossip validators because cache wasn't updated for C1. Spec SG-010 INV-003 violated. Severity calibration: equivocation detection bypass enables slashing avoidance for malicious validators. Affects Prysm validators (~31% of CL). High severity justified: enables slashing evasion, crosses 33% threshold when combined with other client bugs.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-010 INV-003: anti-equivocation cache MUST be updated regardless of publishing

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: streamBlobBatch (rpc_blob_sidecars_by_range.go:28-56) serves all blobs in requested range using MaxBlobsForEpoch() for iteration count (line 31), with no epoch-based filtering. BlobRPCMinValidSlot computes minStart = max(currEpoch - minReqEpochs, DenebForkEpoch) but does not cap at FULU_FORK_EPOCH during transition. Spec SG-011 INV-002 requires transition period to serve only pre-Fulu blobs. Uncertainty: without seeing full request validation chain and testing if FULU_FORK_EPOCH is actually reached in practice, cannot definitively confirm exploitability. Likely vulnerability but validation logic may exist in untested code paths. Spec cross-ref: SG-011 explicitly mandates serve_range = [min(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), FULU_FORK_EPOCH) during transition. Severity: protocol violation during critical fork transition, affects ~31% of CL nodes.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-011 INV-002: transition period serves only pre-Fulu epoch blobs (epoch < FULU_FORK_EPOCH)
